# TIMETABLE_2026-27.md — the real timetable, measured

**Pass PEQ-YEAR-3 §1.** Generated by `_passpq/tools/timetable_extract.py`; every row
cites the workbook cell it came from. **The source workbooks are evidence and are
never committed to this repository** — same rule as the ASDAN instruments. Reproduce with:

```
python3 _passpq/tools/timetable_extract.py <Timetables.xlsx> <Colour_coded_teacher_subject_tables.xlsx>
```

**Period grid:** 40 minutes · **P1** 09:30-10:10 · **P2** 10:10-10:50 · **P3** 11:00-11:40 · **P4** 11:40-12:20 · **P5** 12:50-13:30 · **P6** 13:30-14:10

Check-in, daily reading/AR, break, lunch and check-out/Earwig are **not guided slots**
and are excluded — the workbooks' own note says the same (`[1 Teacher subject totals]!A2`).

## The classification rule, printed

| bucket | rule | counts toward |
|---|---|---|
| **(a)** explicitly ASDAN/PEQ | the label literally contains `ASDAN` or `PEQ` | the floor **and** the ceiling |
| **(b)** carryable | PfA · Community/enterprise · Careers · Vocational/practical · Enrichment/outdoor · Catch-up | the ceiling only |
| **(c)** not carryable | English · Maths · Science · PE · Behaviour Intervention · RE/Humanities/Citizenship/Creative arts/ICT/PSHE/RSHE — these bank their own subjects | neither |
| **owner-decision** | reads plausibly as both, or the two workbooks contradict each other | **neither — never silently absorbed** |

## Owner-decision slots — listed, not absorbed

- **Build Wed P6 (13:30-14:10)** — `Behaviour Intervention`  
  workbooks disagree: lane grid says 'Behaviour Intervention', colour-coded Details [1 Teacher subject totals]!G24 says 'DT / practical skills' - c vs b. Not resolved by preference.
- **Build Thu P6 (13:30-14:10)** — `Outdoor learning / regulation`  
  'Outdoor learning' is carryable enrichment; 'regulation' is behaviour-support time, which the rule puts with Behaviour Intervention on the not-carryable side. The label is both, so it is not counted either way.
- **Grow Thu P6 (13:30-14:10)** — `Behaviour Intervention`  
  workbooks disagree: lane grid says 'Behaviour Intervention', colour-coded Details [1 Teacher subject totals]!G12 says 'DT / practical skills' - c vs b. Not resolved by preference.
- **Launch Thu P5 (12:50-13:30)** — `Behaviour Intervention`  
  workbooks disagree: lane grid says 'Behaviour Intervention', colour-coded Details [1 Teacher subject totals]!G34 says 'DT / practical skills' - c vs b. Not resolved by preference.

## Workbook disagreements

**3 disagreement(s), all material.** A *refinement* (the lane grid's bare
`PfA` where the teacher sheet writes `PfA / ASDAN` or `PfA / cooking`) is **not** counted as a
disagreement — the second label contains the first and adds the detail this pass needs. A
*contradiction* is where neither label contains the other; those are the rows below.

| lane | day | period | lane grid says | source | other source says | source | effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Build | Wed | P6 | `Behaviour Intervention` | `[Build Timetable]!D12` | `DT / practical skills` | colour-coded Details [1 Teacher subject totals]!G24 | c vs b — **material** |
| Grow | Thu | P6 | `Behaviour Intervention` | `[Grow Timetable]!E12` | `DT / practical skills` | colour-coded Details [1 Teacher subject totals]!G12 | c vs b — **material** |
| Launch | Thu | P5 | `Behaviour Intervention` | `[Launch Timetable]!E11` | `DT / practical skills` | colour-coded Details [1 Teacher subject totals]!G34 | c vs b — **material** |

**Not resolved by preference.** DT/practical is carryable; Behaviour Intervention is not.
All three are counted as owner-decision and lodged.

- `[Grow Timetable]!B11` reads **`ICT/Computinh`** — a typo for *Computing*. The workbooks are

- `[Grow Timetable]!F9` folds the role into the subject line (`RSHE (Maths Teacher)`) where every

- **Friday P6 is empty on all three lanes** (`F12` in each grid) — 3 unallocated slots.
